text: A dream of crystal trees.

speaker: Narrator
text: You dream of crystal trees under a huge red sun that is slowly going out.

speaker: Narrator
text: The wind moves through the branches like a sad song.

speaker: Narrator
text: A whisper, soft as leaves: Find the one who listens.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mud everywhere. Sporix is worn out, and you scoop it up gently.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mud everywhere. Plazmo is worn out, and you scoop it up gently.

text: Mud everywhere. Gloopa is worn out, and you scoop it up gently.

text: Cactling takes the hit.

speaker: Narrator
text: A rock cracks loose from the canyon wall and tumbles at Zib!

speaker: Narrator
text: A grumpy Cactling leaps in front, curls into a spiky ball and takes the hit. THUNK.

speaker: Narrator
text: It folds its stubby arms and stares at you. Well? Are you going to ask?

speaker: Narrator
text: Sporix throws itself in the way. When the dust clears, the agents are gone.

speaker: Narrator
text: Plazmo throws itself in the way. When the dust clears, the agents are gone.

speaker: Narrator
text: Gloopa throws itself in the way. When the dust clears, the agents are gone.

text: Dax's giant boulder beast raises one huge foot over Sporix.

speaker: Narrator
text: Dax's giant boulder beast raises one huge foot over Plazmo.

speaker: Narrator
text: Dax's giant boulder beast raises one huge foot over Gloopa.

speaker: Narrator
text: You shout NOW! Sporix blasts the cracked ground, and the rock gives way.

speaker: Narrator
text: You shout NOW! Plazmo blasts the cracked ground, and the rock gives way.

speaker: Narrator
text: You shout NOW! Gloopa blasts the cracked ground, and the rock gives way.

speaker: Narrator
text: Dr. Moor's poison has Sporix covered in spots and hanging still...

speaker: Narrator
text: Dr. Moor's poison has Plazmo covered in spots and hanging still...

speaker: Narrator
text: Dr. Moor's poison has Gloopa covered in spots and hanging still...

speaker: Narrator
text: The ghost ship's cages.

speaker: Narrator
text: A logbook lies open, stamped with an orange slashed ring: Approved, Admin V.

speaker: Narrator
text: In the very last cage: a knitted blanket and a note, signed with just one letter. S.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Glitchbug swarm.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Helix crate bursts open, and hundreds of Glitchbugs pour out!

speaker: Narrator
text: Signs flash backwards, trains freeze in midair, and a hot dog stand plays opera.

speaker: Narrator
text: One cheeky Glitchbug zaps the top of your head.

speaker: Narrator
text: The temple sings.

speaker: Narrator
text: A sunbeam zigzags from mirror to mirror onto the door crystal.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Monolets bow low, and the little Chimelet swings out one pure note. Dinnnng.

speaker: Narrator
text: Every wall hums, and the great doors swing slowly open.

speaker: Narrator
text: Into the light.

speaker: Narrator
text: Old Basalt points his pick at the glowing crater.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Teo stood right there, smiling. Then he walked into the light.

speaker: Narrator
text: Teeth in the ice.

speaker: Narrator
text: Inside the glacier, Ingrid holds up her lantern.

speaker: Narrator
text: The fossil in the ice has a bite mark bigger than a house.

speaker: Narrator
text: A spiky new friend.

speaker: Narrator
text: In the snow, a little Iceburr is stuck, one leg frozen into the ice.

speaker: Narrator
text: Kit melts it free with a heater coil off his tool belt... and it hops onto his shoulder.

speaker: Narrator
text: Project Unity.

speaker: Narrator
text: A cold white sign hangs over endless rows of cages: PROJECT UNITY. ONE OF EVERY SPECIES.

speaker: Narrator
text: Every cage has a label and a number, like a museum.

speaker: Narrator
text: An acceptable loss.

speaker: Narrator
text: The big screen goes dark. Sola does not move.

speaker: Narrator
text: Her fists are shaking.

speaker: Narrator
text: He's my dad.

speaker: Narrator
text: Sola tears the Helix patch off her sleeve.

text: She is scattered so she may live.

speaker: Narrator
text: The whole shrine wall is one great carving.

quest_title: She is scattered so she may live

text: A great tree breaks into a thousand glowing seeds and scatters across the stars.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mortimer Kade spreads the Rift engine plans across the table.

quest_title: The man who built the engine
speaker: Kade
text: I scratched the logo off my coat the day I understood what it would wake.

speaker: Narrator
text: Every boat sounds its horn.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Harbor Tower blazes back to life.

speaker: Narrator
text: Every boat in Port Saltreach sounds its horn.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib's pod.

speaker: Narrator
text: In a valley of cracked seedpods, Zib stops at one small shell.

speaker: Narrator
text: It sits inside for a long, quiet minute. This was Zib's pod.

speaker: Narrator
text: Pell raises the net gun at Zib. His hands are shaking.

speaker: Narrator
text: Then he throws it over the rim, down into the crater's light.

speaker: Narrator
text: Novaryx.

speaker: Narrator
text: Your eight Shards rise and sing.

speaker: Narrator
text: A great signal-winged bird answers the call.

speaker: Narrator
text: Freeze the coils!

speaker: Narrator
text: A Helix gravity trap pins everyone flat to the glowing rock.

speaker: Narrator
text: You're so tall.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Rift folds shut. From the last of its light steps Teo Reyes.

speaker: Narrator
text: Sola runs to him.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Starfall Festival.

speaker: Narrator
text: All of Dustmere is out at the Bonfire Ring tonight.

speaker: Narrator
text: Old Dusty tells the story of the night the seedpods fell.

speaker: Narrator
text: The trial.

speaker: Narrator
text: In the Linker League courtroom, Director Thorne pleads guilty.

speaker: Narrator
text: He looks at no one.

speaker: Narrator
text: Prime Linker.

speaker: Narrator
text: Under the Great Telescope, Orra Venn bows.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: The Kessler system has a new Prime Linker.

speaker: Narrator
text: The road of light.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Go. I'll hold the road open from this side.

speaker: Narrator
text: Ystra.

speaker: Narrator
text: A huge, tired red sun hangs over a grey world.

speaker: Narrator
text: Far off, at the bottom of an empty crater, one faint green glow: the Heartroot.

speaker: Narrator
text: Saga's face.

speaker: Narrator
text: Saga lowers the hood.

speaker: Narrator
text: Underneath is a face like clear crystal, flickering at the edges.

speaker: Narrator
text: Small and silver.

speaker: Narrator
text: The darkness folds in on itself... and Oblivane is calm at last.

speaker: Narrator
text: Small and silver, it curls up like a sleepy moon.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Seedmother grows again.

speaker: Narrator
text: A world-tree of crystal and leaves rises out of the crater.

speaker: Narrator
text: Oblivane sleeps in her branches like a little silver moon.

speaker: Narrator
text: A road between two worlds.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Warp Gate's runes blaze cyan and pink.

speaker: Narrator
text: A road between two worlds, open at last.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib zips in a happy loop around your head. Bip!

speaker: Narrator
text: Before you leave Dustmere, you should take your new friend home to meet Mom.

speaker: Narrator
text: Mom looks up from the kitchen table... and right into one huge blinking eye.

speaker: Mom
text: Well, hello to you too! And who is THIS?

speaker: Mom
text: A little saucer from the canyon? Any friend of yours is welcome in this house.

speaker: Mom
text: So it's really happening. Dr. Vashti says you're ready to head out past the bridge.

speaker: Mom
text: Before you go... this was your Nana Wren's. She wore it every day she ran the Recovery Bay.

speaker: Narrator
text: It's a brass cross with a glowing blue core. Stamped on the back: R.B. No. 1.

speaker: Mom
text: And you're not leaving without this. Your backpack. Snacks, a map, a spare pair of socks. Don't argue.

speaker: Mom
text: Call home once in a while, Rook. Promise me.

speaker: Narrator
text: Unbeknownst to Rook or his mother, someone else had already found that backpack.

speaker: Narrator
text: Hidden deep inside, beneath the snacks and the socks, an unknown guest curled up tight... and held its breath.

speaker: Narrator
text: Far away, on Helix Station, Sola stands beside Director Thorne at a window full of stars.

speaker: Narrator
text: ...Back on Glyphos, Zib blinks. For a split second, its big eye reflects something enormous: a giant dark eye, slowly opening.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: That badge... R.B. No. 1. Wren's. I knew a man who wore a jacket too big for him, and a woman who wore that badge. Good people.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: Here. Teo left his old mining lantern with me. It never quite goes out. Take it down the Deep Mines.

speaker: Old Basalt
text: And catch yourself an Ashpup. Those sooty pups love lantern light, and they can sniff out a hidden ledge.

speaker: Narrator
text: Behind a hidden ledge, Teo's lantern flares. There's a little crystal recorder wedged in the rock.

speaker: Teo Reyes
text: [recording] If you find this, Sola, I'm not lost. I'm following them home.

speaker: Narrator
text: Tucked under the recorder is a page torn from Teo's journal. He copied one line from Imogen Vashti's Codex pages, and the stone it came from was damaged:

speaker: Narrator
text: "She is scattered so she may live..." The rest of the line is gone.

speaker: Teo Reyes
text: [note] Imogen never told us how it ends. I think it's the most important line in the whole Codex.

speaker: Narrator
text: You'd better keep the recording safe for Sola.

speaker: Narrator
text: Frozen into the mirror ice is a second little cache. Inside: a map carved from crystal.

speaker: Narrator
text: Scratched along its edge in Teo's handwriting: "the floating gardens beyond the light."

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: You came all this way to stop me? I'm SO close to finding my dad!

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: ...Fine. You win. But Helix is going to find him. They promised.

speaker: Admin Vex
text: Two brats for the price of one? The Director will be thrilled.

speaker: Admin Vex
text: Ugh! Fine. The Director already has what he needs.

speaker: Narrator
text: On the way out, the freed captives flood past you. One stays behind: a tiny crystal hatchling that glows like Teo's lantern.

speaker: Narrator
text: It's a Lumivex hatchling. It looks at Sola for a long moment, then climbs into her jacket pocket.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: ...Hi. Hi, little one. Okay. You can come with me.

speaker: Narrator
text: On the shuttle home, Sola falls asleep against your shoulder, the hatchling glowing softly in her pocket.

speaker: Narrator
text: At the last wind shrine, the Ystran echo Liss is clearer than ever.

speaker: Liss
text: I launched the last seedpod. The one carrying Zib. The fold was closing, and someone had to push it through.

speaker: Liss
text: I stayed behind on purpose. Someone had to sing it on its way.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib's lights flicker through every color, then go soft and blue. It's crying in lights.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: I built Thorne's Rift engine. Look at the key slot. It's tuned to one frequency.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: The eighth tower's resonance. The moment you win Shard 8, Thorne gets his key.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: But if you don't, the cracked seal fails on its own. There is no safe answer.

speaker: Sola Reyes
text: Then we do it together. And we stop him at the other end.

speaker: Mortimer Kade
text: ...All right. Gravewell Tower. I'll be waiting.

speaker: Narrator
text: All eight Shards ring at once. Zib rises into the air, and its big eye projects a soft, shimmering light.

speaker: Narrator
text: A woman's voice fills the room, warm and huge, and you know it before she says a word.

speaker: Seedmother
text: If you hear this, my scout found a true listener.

speaker: Seedmother
text: I am not gone. I am in every one of you, scattered so I may live.

speaker: Seedmother
text: Heal the one who hungers, my sibling who took in too much. Then bring my children home together, and I will grow again.

speaker: Captain Marsh
text: A Helix freighter just tied up at the end of my east pier for repairs. Guess what's in its hold?

speaker: Captain Marsh
text: My tower core. The one Vex stole. We're taking it back, tonight.

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Helix Directive! This freighter is restricted!

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Abandon ship! Abandon ship!

speaker: Captain Marsh
text: The freighter won't wait forever. Move!

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Helix Directive! Stand aside, this tower is ours now!

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Retreat! The scrappers won't quit!

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: That's my kid. Battling beside me, not behind me.

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: Helix Directive! Shut that broadcast down!

speaker: Helix Grunt
text: They're... they're still on the air!

speaker: Narrator
text: A battered Helix shuttle drops into Dustmere's plaza. The hatch opens. It's Strand.

speaker: Strand
text: Field Division. Second Class. ...Resigning.

speaker: Strand
text: Ostrander's soldiers have the crater sealed tight. But nobody stops a Helix shuttle. Get in. I'll fly you past the cordon.

speaker: Narrator
text: You don't reach for a pod. You just hold out your hand, the way Tamsin taught you: a capture isn't taking, it's asking.

speaker: Narrator
text: Novaryx tilts its great signal wings and looks at you for a long time.

speaker: Narrator
text: Then it lowers its head until its glow touches Zib. Zib bips, very softly.

speaker: Narrator
text: Novaryx will guide you down into the crater. Its light shows the way.

speaker: Director Thorne
text: Do you know what infinite energy means? It means no accident is ever final.

speaker: Director Thorne
text: ...Elena isn't in there. There's nothing in there but hunger.

speaker: Narrator
text: Every Alienmon's song folds into one voice: a woman's, warm and huge. For a heartbeat the Seedmother is whole.

speaker: Narrator
text: Fungaroth blazes like a small star and pushes the Rift closed with light.

speaker: Narrator
text: Solarach blazes like a small star and pushes the Rift closed with light.

speaker: Narrator
text: Abyssor blazes like a small star and pushes the Rift closed with light.

speaker: Narrator
text: Dustmere is celebrating twenty years since the Starfall. The bridge glows all on its own.

speaker: Dusty
text: Twenty years ago, four kids climbed down into that crater and found the Mother Pod. I always told it like a fairy tale. Tonight I'll tell it true.

speaker: Dusty
text: Imogen Vashti. Kael Thorne. Orra Venn. And Teo Reyes.

speaker: Narrator
text: Everybody around the fire turns and looks at Teo. He just smiles and pokes the coals.

speaker: Narrator
text: Up in the Recovery Bay attic, under a dusty blanket, you find Nana Wren's journal.

speaker: Nana Wren
text: [journal] The night the stars fell, three pods of baby saucers came to my door. Little things with one big eye, like scouts.

speaker: Nana Wren
text: [journal] I nursed them all night. And I heard a voice singing, far away and so tired. So I sang back.

speaker: Nana Wren
text: [journal] Every pod sang a different note of the same song. I think they're all pieces of one mother. So I sang the missing notes back.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib chose you because the same Signal runs in your family.

speaker: Nana Wren
text: [journal, last page] I built a little robot to listen for the scout's frequency, and to watch over my grandchild when I can't.

speaker: Nana Wren
text: [journal] I taught him my favorite word. Probably.

speaker: Narrator
text: DX-4 is quiet for a long, long time.

speaker: DX-4
text: I KNEW THAT. PROBABLY.

speaker: Admin Vex
text: You again?! I'm not going back to that Director. I'm not going ANYWHERE!

speaker: Admin Vex
text: No... no, no, no!

speaker: Narrator
text: Captain Marsh clamps the cuffs on Admin Vex. Marsh: That's for my tower. And my harbor. And my logbook.

speaker: Narrator
text: Pell steps up onto the deck, chest out. Pell: Helix Directive! Field Division! ...

speaker: Pell
text: ...Former.

speaker: Captain Marsh
text: Not bad, kid. There's room on my crew for a man who knows when to quit.

speaker: Mom
text: Go on, enjoy the festival. You've earned it.

speaker: Narrator
text: Before you leave for the Summit, Hank hands Kit a Gearhound and his old welding goggles.

speaker: Hank Briggs
text: You fix everything for everybody, kid. Let somebody look after you for once.

speaker: Narrator
text: Kit puts the goggles on. They're much too big. Kit doesn't take them off for a week.

speaker: Marisol Fenn
text: This crystal cut the first Signal Shard. Twenty years ago, four kids built the very first Linker around it.

speaker: Marisol Fenn
text: Vashti did the biology, Orra the signal, Kael the engineering. Teo just kept saying it would work. It did.

speaker: Duke Harrow
text: I wrote the anthem they played the day the Linker League was founded.

speaker: Duke Harrow
text: That same night, Orra and Vashti locked the Codex away in this mountain. I watched them do it. Nobody sang about that part.

speaker: Narrator
text: As Saga's last Alienmon falls, Saga leans close and whispers one word. It isn't any language you know.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib's lights flash every color at once. Nobody else seems to notice.

speaker: General Ostrander
text: I guarded that crater for twenty years. I'll tell you something I never put in a report.

speaker: General Ostrander
text: Six years ago I saw Teo Reyes walk into the light. I could have stopped him. He looked so happy. So I let him go.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: My first Linker still works. Let's see if yours can carry what mine carried.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: I kept the Codex locked up for nineteen years and called it protecting people.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: You carried the truth across fourteen worlds, in the open. That's the difference.

speaker: Orra Venn
text: Tonight Imogen and I will tell every world the whole prophecy, in the open. They should know what the Reunion is.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: Thorne's Codex page. "A door that is a road, opened only by a scout and a listener together."

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: The Great Telescope can focus all eight Shards into a Vortex, if the lens is right. So Kit and I built one from Teo's crystal map.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: The Shards are set. Nothing's happening. ...A scout and a listener. Of course. You and Zib, together.

speaker: Dr. Vashti
text: And every Keeper has promised: when the call comes, they'll bring their Alienmon through.

speaker: Narrator
text: At the bottom of the empty crater, the Heartroot glows very faintly. It's almost dark.

speaker: Narrator
text: You understand all at once: one team isn't enough. The legend needs every Alienmon. All of her children, together.

speaker: Seedmother
text: Little scout. Your mission is done. You can stay home now, with me.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib looks up at the Seedmother. Then it looks at you, for a long time.

speaker: Seedmother
text: A scout's job is to find a home. You found one.

speaker: Narrator
text: Zib zips back to your shoulder, every light glowing gold.

speaker: Narrator
text: One year later.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Warp Gate hums over Dustmere. Through it, green against Ystra's new sky, you can see the Seedmother's tree.

speaker: Narrator
text: Tamsin is still exploring Ystra. Teo and Dr. Vashti run a research station between the worlds.

speaker: Narrator
text: Admin Vex is still in prison, and Captain Marsh still visits just to gloat.

speaker: Narrator
text: A letter arrives from Kael Thorne: "I wanted to own her. You set her free. Elena would have liked you. Tell your Zib thank you."

speaker: Narrator
text: At the Observatory, a nervous new thirteen-year-old is choosing a first partner.

speaker: Narrator
text: Over on the table, one shy capsule sits all alone. Nobody picked it. You walk over to it.

speaker: Narrator
text: THE END of the Alienmon Chronicles. (Every Alienmon is a piece of her. Open the Xenodex and press A to see the Heartroot.)

speaker: Narrator
text: The Chirpod chirps happily and tucks itself under your collar.

speaker: Narrator
text: The Chirpod circles you three times, then flies off over the harbor, singing.
